text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it affirmed its A plus long-term and A1 short-term ratings of Whitbread Plc.

"Whitbread's focus on successful and rapidly expanding branded food, drink and leisure retail operations has provided a degree of protection against a difficult brewing market," IBCA said in a statement.

The company's financial profile remains strong despite a series of acquisitions over the last 18 months, although it has experienced free cash outflows in line with continued investment spending, IBCA said.

"Substantial capital expenditure is envisaged for the future as Whitbread rolls-out additional branded outlets in its pub, restaurant and hotel businesses but the company is comfortably able to support such levels of investment which generate increased sales and profits," IBCA said.
